sentences.text: Learned senior counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner has clean antecedent and he has falsely been implicated in the present case.
In fact, the petitioner was in love with the victim girl and the allegation as alleged in the FIR is false and fabricated.
He further submits that the petitioner has stated in paragraph 10 of the bail petition that the petitioner is ready to perform marriage with the victim girl as soon as he came out from the jail.
Apart from that, both sides are ready for marriage and both the parties has filed the petition before the learned Court below in this regard.
The petitioner is in custody since 11.03.2025.
5. The learned counsel for the informant fairly submits that the victim girl is ready to perform marriage with the petitioner.

6. Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances, the petitioner has stated in the bail petition that he is ready to perform marriage with the victim girl, hence, let the petitioner, above named, be released on provisional bail for a period of three months on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/-
(Ten Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned S.D.J.M.,
Aurangabad in connection with Mahila P.S. Case No. 72 of 2024, subject to the following conditions:-
i. Petitioner shall co-operate in the trial and shall be Patna High Court CR. MISC.

No.38510 of 2025(3) dt.08-08-2025 properly represented on each and every date fixed by the court and shall remain physically present as directed by the court and on his absence on two consecutive dates without sufficient reason, his bail bond shall be cancelled by the Court below.
ii. If the petitioner tampers with the evidence or the witnesses, in that case, the prosecution will be at liberty to move for cancellation of bail.

iii. And further condition that the court below shall verify the criminal antecedent of the petitioner and in case at any stage it is found that the petitioner has concealed his criminal antecedent, the court below shall take step for cancellation of bail bond of the petitioner.
However, the acceptance of bail bonds in terms of the above-mentioned order shall not be delayed for purpose of or in the name of verification.
7. Learned counsel for the petitioner is directed to file an affidavit stating therein that the petitioner has performed marriage with the girl within the aforesaid period.

8. Put up this case on 07.11.2025.
(Rajesh Kumar Verma, J) priyanka/-
